text:
maya: Heads-up: main is CI-red after yesterday's lockfile regen PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/523). macos-latest jobs failing during install/import step, linux/windows are green.
ci-bot: Build #12987 failed: macos-latest / test-matrix — https://ci.redwood/in/12987 :warning:
sam: @maya can you paste the failing log snippet so we can triage quickly?
maya: sure — see paste: ```
Error: OSError: dlopen(/opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.10.9/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/cattrs/_cattr.cpython-310-darwin.so, 0x0002): tried: '/opt/.../_cattr.cpython-310-darwin.so' (no suitable image found)
ImportError: dynamic module does not define module export function (PyInit__cattr)
```
maya: only repros on mac runners, locally on my mac VM I can reproduce the same import error after installing from the lockfile.
liam: @maya which deps changed in the lock regen? anything with C extensions (cattrs, cryptography, orjson, etc)?
maya: lock diff shows cattrs 22.2 -> 23.0, cryptography bumped too but the import trace is directly failing on cattrs.
anya: mac runners are universal2/arm64 hosts; could be a wheel ABI mismatch. sometimes pip picks a wheel built for a different macos/Python tag.
sam: can someone try pip -v install output to see the exact wheel filename and tags?
maya: repro steps I ran on my mac VM: ```
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -U pip
pip install -r ci/requirements.txt  # using the repo lockfile
pytest tests/unit/test_config.py -q
```
maya: during install I get: ```
Downloaded cattrs-23.0-cp310-cp310-macosx_11_0_universal2.whl
Saved /Users/maya/.cache/pip/wheels/...
Processing cattrs-23.0-cp310-cp310-macosx_11_0_universal2.whl
ImportError: dynamic module does not define module export function (PyInit__cattr)
```
sre-oncall: tagging @eng-sre :eyes: I'll rerun the mac job — sometimes a rerun clears infra flakiness.
ci-bot: Re-run job triggered by @sre-oncall: https://ci.redwood/in/12987/retry
ci-bot: Rerun finished: macos-latest passed (flaky) — tests now green on rerun :white_check_mark:
sam: weird — flaky pass on rerun but maya can still repro locally. maybe pip cached an older wheel that works? try pip cache purge and reinstall.
maya: tried pip cache purge + reinstall, still fails locally.
liam: hypothesis: the universal2 wheel was built against a different Python ABIs export symbol name (PyInit__cattr). Could be a build artifact mismatch at upstream publishing. Check the wheel build metadata (Wheel-ABI) and the compile details.
sam: quick mitigation: pin cattrs back to 22.2 in pyproject.toml/constraints and run a canary PR to see if macos CI becomes stable. If it does, we know cattrs 23.0 is the culprit.
maya: opened a tiny pin PR and attached failing job link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/526
ci-bot: Canary build for pr/526 started.
ci-bot: Canary build passed on macos-latest :white_check_mark:
maya: ok that narrows it down to cattrs 23.0. I'll open an upstream issue + link logs. @liam can you try building cattrs 23.0 from source on a mac host and inspect the compiled extension symbol?
liam: will try later today. also check whether the published wheel was built with the right build backend (setuptools vs pyproject/maturin) — cattrs has CFFI bits so build method matters.
sre-oncall: to restore main green I'll revert the lockfile regen (revert PR 523) for now and follow up with an investigation ticket.
maya: thanks — filing follow-up issue with logs and artifacts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/issues/789
sam: long-term: add a smoke job to our lockfile CI that validates installing binary deps on macos runners after lock regen to catch this earlier.
anya: +1 to the smoke job idea.
liam: quick bisect thought if needed: git bisect between sha 123abc456 (last green) and abcdef1234 (lock regen commit) but since this is a packaging wheel issue the bisect will point to the lock change anyway.
maya: agree, bisect will confirm the PR as the change but we've already narrowed to the vendor (cattrs).
sam: cool — moving this to blocker until revert lands. thanks everyone for the quick help. :heart:
